task: D6.1 opt-in read-only overview pipeline-status shadow
decision: The existing overview page keeps its URL, layout, route projection, visual fields, and legacy data source. An explicit manager_compare=true request attaches a read-only pipeline shadow with the latest run, current step, checkpoint, step-status counts, events count, and upstream consistency diagnostics.

implementation.cachePolicy: The route uses a shallow top-level copy before attaching managerShadow so the manager diagnostic is not written into the existing overview cache object.

fixtures: overview shadow is disabled without network access while MANAGER_UI_DATA_SOURCE=legacy
overview shadow reads only the pipeline status endpoint with chainId and request id
pipeline latest-run, current-step, checkpoint, upstream assessment, event, and step-status counts are exposed
legacy overview route counts remain present as a separate diagnostic namespace
overview page attaches managerShadow only when manager_compare=true
knownBoundary: Overview shadow is pipeline orchestration visibility only. It does not replace the legacy route projection and does not prove row-level version equivalence across all modules. Dedicated review/broadcast detail pages remain pending. No production database migration, service restart, manager write, or broadcast was performed.
